name: micro-fe-demo
description: Developer convenience scripts only. Every app under apps/ builds, tests and deploys entirely on its own; nothing here is required to build any of them.

scripts.build:apps: npm --prefix apps/shell run build && npm --prefix apps/mfe-orders run build && npm --prefix apps/mfe-catalog run build
scripts.build: npm run build:platform && npm run build:apps
scripts.test:unit: npm --prefix packages/platform test && npm --prefix apps/shell test && npm --prefix apps/mfe-orders test && npm --prefix apps/mfe-catalog test
